body:
The design agent gets its own narrow set of Solace commands, and is told only what it can do (D-96).

### Do

- A design run can read code, tasks, decisions, the vision, the personas and designs, as a strategy run reads the plan and code. It can also reply to the human with a waiting note. Everything else is refused.
- It can't change code, tasks, features or milestones.
- Give it its own tool description, hints and refusals in `solace mcp`, with no task-run or strategy advice.
- Add a `help` section, and document the commands in the reference.

### Acceptance

- Tests: each allowed read works in a design run, a code change and a task change are refused, a run's note reaches the human and waits, and a refusal gives no task-run advice.

### Left out

Proposing a change to a design, which is the next task but one.
title: agent: design run commands
